heading: Tonight
text: Becoming clear and cool. Areas of dense valley fog. Lows in the 40s except for a few 50s in the Champlain Valley and south. North wind diminishing to light.

heading: Saturday
text: Any dense valley fog burning off to partly or mostly sunny skies. Highs ranging from the low 70s in the far north to nearing 80 in the warmer southern valleys. Light west wind.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Mostly clear, mixing with clouds from the west after midnight. Areas of dense river valley fog. Lows ranging through the 50s. Light wind, becoming south near 10 mph west of the Greens.
